title: The Winter Passes
heat: Open door, moderate: 2 to 3 explicit scenes per book, each tied to a truth that changes the bond
subgenre: Romantasy (core): survival-adventure romantasy built on Himachal mountain-spirit folklore

books.couple: Meera (29, smuggler-guide) and Rohan (35, captain of the queen's pass-wardens)
books.central_question: Will Meera get the medicine through to Ranu, and will Rohan arrest her?
books.hinge: At the thaw the jogini warn that the Old Bargain is unpaid and the pass will close forever after the fourth winter unless someone pays.

books.couple: Ila (31, crown pass-surveyor) and Kunal (33, rebel prince of Neshar)
books.central_question: Will Ila map the hidden passes for the queen or hide them for Neshar?
books.hinge: The Under-Cairn carving reads 'carried till no thaw', the last payer was Ila's grandfather, and Regent Pritam escapes.

books.couple: Lata (42, widowed wool trader) and Tej (45, the regent's exiled general)
books.central_question: Will Lata stand surety for the exiled general whose soldiers burned her family's sheds, and take their second chance across a war?
books.hinge: Mohit's ledgers reveal the Bargain's original price was a promise, not a death, and Kiran leaves to pay it with his life.

books.couple: Kiran (27, smuggler and Meera's brother) and Asha (31, rival crew boss and Hemi's descendant)
books.central_question: Who pays the spirits' Old Bargain, and with what?
books.hinge: Series close: the pass stays open forever, Kiran and Asha are bound every winter for life, and a stranger at the cairn asks to be carried across.
